summary: Created a 7-phase implementation plan adopting `bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/x.sh` across all 34 CWD-relative hook registrations in 4 source-store JSON files, plus the missing merge-source counterpart for validate-state-sync.sh. The plan rules in a mandatory, idempotent migration script for already-deployed repos (install-once root-files cannot reach them) and rules out the settings.local.json permission matchers with reason. Acceptance criteria 1/2/5 are demonstrated against two real pre-existing deploys; criteria 4 and 6 are asserted by extensions to the existing deploy-propagation harness and a new migration test. The standing lint/verify-deploy gate is deliberately left to task 365 to avoid colliding on its declared territory.

artifacts.summary: 7 phases, 6.5h, waves [[1,3,7],[2,4],[5],[6]]: source-store registration fix, install-once warning, migration script, migration test, deploy-harness assertions, real-deploy demonstration, markdown templates.
